features.featureTitle: Update backend transfer/balance APIs to be consistent: either (a) keep the existing backend methods used by the current frontend (getBalance(principal) and transfer(to, amount)) as backward-compatible wrappers around the ICRC-1 ledger, or (b) update the frontend React Query hooks and wallet UI to call the ICRC-1 transfer/balance endpoints. Ensure user-facing text remains in English.
